The proposal reads clearly, so I made no rewrite. `node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags. It's a brief for agents, with a clear title and three numbered questions, Q3, Q4 and Q2. It also states the output file and its limits.

One thing is slightly off: its opening paragraph runs past 60 words. I left it as is, since only agents read it. I did not shoot a page, because the folder has no `page.js`.

I logged one `clear` line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.
